title: Road Generator
cue: roads with lanes, markings, crossings, traffic that follows
summary: Roads built from points: lanes with markings, shoulders, slopes and bends, crossings where roads meet, collision, and lanes that traffic follows.
useWhen: A 3D game needs real roads: a street grid, a highway, a race or delivery route, a town with crossings, or traffic that drives in lanes. A few points in code give a road mesh with markings and collision that a hand-built mesh would take hours to match.
avoidWhen: The track is one closed circuit of a kit's own pieces, as in starter-kit-racing, a dirt path that a terrain texture or a CSG ribbon shows well enough, or a 2D game.
